mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 62 degrees near the Verona Public Library. Please be aware that air quality is currently at a moderate level of 56. While the moon is in a Waxing Gibbous phase, there are no visible ISS passes tonight.

In city news, the I Voted sticker design contest for students has officially closed. We had a great response from local kids in grades K-12, and the community will be able to vote for the winning designs from each age category between July 28 and August 7. Also, residents are reminded to review the mailbox damage policy to ensure mailboxes meet federal specifications before the next snow season.

There is plenty to do locally starting today. We have the Dane County Farmers Market at the State Capitol, plus live music performances happening today at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on July 27, followed by trivia nights and the Verona Downtown Farmers Market at Hometown Junction Park early next week.

Looking at the police department report from the week of July 13 to July 20, we had a noteworthy incident on Monday, July 13, when a 36-year-old driver was arrested for an O-W-I offense after his vehicle became stuck on a rock.
Today is a great day to visit the store for the Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough flavor. They are currently closed but will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM today.
